<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918187_theRebbe_312" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918187_theRebbe_312__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that "this month is for you" signifies the service of Israel by their own power, encompassing two modes of service that correspond to miraculous and natural conduct.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is: "This month is for you the head of months, it is the first for you among the months of the year,"</t>
    <t s="1">that the entirety of the concept of "this month is for you"</t>
    <t s="2">(since He chose Yaakov and his children)</t>
    <t s="3">indicates the service of Israel by their own power,</t>
    <t s="4">except that within this very thing there are two modes of service upon which depend two modes of conduct in the world,</t>
    <t s="5">miraculous conduct,</t>
    <t s="6">the concept of Rosh Chodesh Nissan,</t>
    <t s="7">the new moon of redemption,</t>
    <t s="8">and natural conduct,</t>
    <t s="9">the concept of the months of the year,</t>
    <t s="10">for "year" indicates natural conduct,</t>
    <t s="11">and "the months of the year" indicates that natural conduct depends on the service of Israel,</t>
    <t s="12">"this month is for you."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section connects the discussion to the maamar "V'Har Sinai Ashan" 5628, explaining that "year" relates to Rosh Chodesh through the twelve diagonal boundaries of the Sefiros, while "world" and "soul" represent higher levels.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And one should add and connect this with what is explained in the discourse "V'Har Sinai Ashan" 5628,</t>
    <t s="2">and this is its language: "Ashan" is an acronym for "Olam, Shanah, Nefesh" (World, Year, Soul),</t>
    <t s="3">and our master, my father-in-law, of blessed memory, explained that "year" refers to the twelve new moons, which are the twelve diagonal boundaries of the Sefiros, as is discussed at length in the discourse "Mechar Chodesh,"</t>
    <t s="4">and presumably he heard this from the Maggid, of blessed memory,</t>
    <t s="5">and "world" is the aspect of the Sefiros in their essence,</t>
    <t s="6">and this is because it is said, "For I said, 'The world is built with kindness,'"</t>
    <t s="7">and it is written, "Remember Your mercies and Your kindnesses, for they are from the world,"</t>
    <t s="8">that the aspect of "world" is from the aspect of the Sefiros,</t>
    <t s="9">and "soul" is the life-force of the world,</t>
    <t s="10">and it follows that it explains that the aspect of "soul" is higher than all of them,</t>
    <t s="11">end of his language.</t>
    <t s="12">And the concept in this,</t>
    <t s="13">that even "year" is connected with Rosh Chodesh,</t>
    <t s="14">for this is the matter of the twelve new moons of the year,</t>
    <t s="15">except that they are the twelve diagonal boundaries of the Sefiros,</t>
    <t s="16">that is,</t>
    <t s="17">that this is not the aspect of the Sefiros as they are in their place,</t>
    <t s="18">but rather as they are in diagonal boundaries,</t>
    <t s="19">and their concept in the Sefiros is the aspect of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="20">whose "feet descend"</t>
    <t s="21">into Biyah,</t>
    <t s="22">and even as it is in Atzilus, it is in the aspect of connection to the worlds of Biyah</t>
    <t s="23">(this is the root of natural conduct).</t>
    <t s="24">And above this,</t>
    <t s="25">the aspect of "world,"</t>
    <t s="26">the aspect of the Sefiros in their essence,</t>
    <t s="27">that is,</t>
    <t s="28">that which is above the worlds of Biyah</t>
    <t s="29">(this is the root of miraculous conduct).</t>
    <t s="30">And above this,</t>
    <t s="31">the aspect of "soul,"</t>
    <t s="32">the Sefirah of Binah,</t>
    <t s="33">which is the life-force of the world and consequently also the life-force of "year"</t>
    <t s="34">(which alludes to the service of Israel upon which depend the two modes of conduct of miracle and nature,</t>
    <t s="35">that is, Zeir Anpin and Malchus).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section suggests that the three Torah readings of this Shabbos—Parshas Vayikra, Parshas HaChodesh, and U'Vrashei Chodsheichem—allude to the levels of Nefesh, Olam, and Shanah, corresponding to miraculous and natural conduct.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And one may say, as a possibility,</t>
    <t s="2">that this is also hinted at in the three readings of this Shabbos: Parshas Vayikra,</t>
    <t s="3">the beginning of Toras Kohanim,</t>
    <t s="4">which refers to the children of Israel, about whom it is said,</t>
    <t s="5">"And you shall be to Me a kingdom of priests" — the aspect of Nefesh</t>
    <t s="6">(Binah)</t>
    <t s="7">; "This month is for you,"</t>
    <t s="8">the reading of Parshas HaChodesh — the commandment of Rosh Chodesh in the Torah,</t>
    <t s="9">but in most years it is not on the day of Rosh Chodesh in the world — the aspect of "world," which is the aspect of the Sefiros in their essence</t>
    <t s="10">(Zeir Anpin,</t>
    <t s="11">which is above descent into Biyah)</t>
    <t s="12">; and "U'Vrashei Chodsheichem,"</t>
    <t s="13">the reading of Rosh Chodesh — Rosh Chodesh in the world — the aspect of "year," which is the twelve months</t>
    <t s="14">(Malchus,</t>
    <t s="15">whose feet descend into Biyah).</t>
    <t s="16">And according to the above: "U'Vrashei Chodsheichem" — indicates natural conduct</t>
    <t s="17">(Malchus),</t>
    <t s="18">"HaChodesh HaZeh" — indicates miraculous conduct</t>
    <t s="19">(Zeir Anpin),</t>
    <t s="20">and the reading of Toras Kohanim,</t>
    <t s="21">"Vayikra el Moshe" and it is not stated who is calling, etc. — according to one interpretation, it is the aspect of the Makif</t>
    <t s="22">(Kesser,</t>
    <t s="23">also the Makif of Binah,</t>
    <t s="24">a canopy over the groom and bride,</t>
    <t s="25">Zeir Anpin and Nukvah together)</t>
    <t s="26">— the world of freedom.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
